item.title: Building Shiny Apps
item.description: The goal of this workshop is to introduce participants to the development of interactive web applications using Shiny in R. The workshop helps participants understand what Shiny is, how it enables the creation of interactive dashboards and data-exploration tools, and how applications are structured. Participants learn key concepts such as reactive programming, the architecture of Shiny applications, and how user inputs and outputs interact to produce dynamic visualizations and analytical tools.
